answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because hollow only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. In practice copper is enforced by the ledger itself: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
